subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openai/codex-action` revision `52fe01ec70a42f454c9d2ebd47598f9fd6893d56` in workflows that provide an OpenAI API key, as part of this grouped action update?
rationale: This is a supply-chain and credential-boundary decision: an automated pin update cannot establish whether the new action implementation preserves the repository’s intended secret isolation and execution contract.

options.title: Audit and prove the revision
options.body: Review the upstream revision’s security-relevant contract and attach redacted successful final-head workflow evidence before merging the grouped update.

options.title: Split the Codex update
options.body: Land only action revisions with completed owner review and move the Codex action revision into a separately reviewed security-focused PR.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Hold this PR until a workflow owner can make and record the security-boundary acceptance decision.

recommendation.title: Audit and prove the revision
recommendation.body: Review the upstream revision’s security-relevant contract and attach redacted successful final-head workflow evidence before merging the grouped update.
